name: CoolDock
tagline: Add a second Dock with live widgets, app shortcuts, and quick actions.
description:
Arrange calendar, reminders, weather, music controls, and system stats beside your usual Dock. Add app and folder shortcuts alongside the widgets you use. CoolDock requires macOS 14 or later. Widget data depends on the integrations you enable.

## Pricing
Lifetime Access includes one year of updates. Forever Edition includes future updates.
pricingDetails: Lifetime and Forever one-time licenses available
